Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (listening 1-16, composing 1-16) into /private/tmp/claude-501/music-second-reader-2010ol/ and read every ask page in full; confirmed on contact sheets that listening 1 (cover), 7 (BLANK PAGE), 12-13 (ROUGH WORK lines), 14-15 (ROUGH WORK staves), 16 (BLANK PAGE) and composing 1 (cover), 2 (BLANK PAGE), 12-15 (ROUGH WORK staves), 16 (BLANK PAGE) carry no ask, matching the file's pagesWithoutAsks. Dumped every text-layer span with its font (PyMuPDF) on listening 2-12 and composing 2-12, listed every non-ASCII code point of both text layers, and zoomed with PyMuPDF clips at 300-400 dpi on: the en dashes in "bars 1–16" (p4 bullet), "bars 1–8" (Q2(ii), Q3(iii)), "bars 17–32" (Q2(iv)), "lines 4–7" (Q4(iii)) (text layer U+2013 throughout); the long dashes of composing Q4's cadence lines "(I—IV—V)", "(ii—IV—I)", "(I—V—vi)", "(IV—V—I)" (p7 at 400 dpi: em-length, text layer U+2014); the curly apostrophes (U+2019) in "She’s Leaving Home" (Q4 lead-in and Q4(v)), "o’clock", "didn’t", "can’t", "She’s leaving home." (p6 lyrics), "I’ll" (p10), "It’s" (p10 heading and lyrics 1, 2, 4), "you’re", "I’m", "can’t" (p11 lyrics); the hyphens in "eight-bar" (composing Q1) and "non-traditional" (Q5 Excerpt 3(iv)); "key note" (two words, composing Q2) against "keynote" (Q1, Q3); the spaced ellipsis ". . ." after the italic title and the colon after "Lewis Carroll" (composing Q2); stops: "by Deane." (Q1 lead-in), "Excerpt 1." / "Excerpt 2." / "Excerpt 3. There is no printed music for this section." (Q1, bold, on p2 and p3), none after "Q. 5 Irish Music", "Excerpt 1." (Q5, with stop) against "Excerpt 2" / "Excerpt 3" (Q5, no stop), "Aural Skills." (Q6, with stop), none after the bare "Excerpt 1/2/3" headings of Q6, none after "Briefly explain your answer" (Q4(iii)), "Explain" (Q6 Excerpt 3(iii)), "at the end of each line" (Q6 Excerpt 1(ii)) or "Name the movement from which this excerpt is taken" (Q2(i)), the stop after the italic "She’s Leaving Home" in Q4(v), the stops after "Q3." and "two sections." in the Section A stem and none after "Q4 or Q5 or Q6" in the Section B stem; lyric line 6 of Q4 ends "can’t buy)" with no stop. Bullets checked on the render: listening Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q6 lead-in bullets; Q5's lead-in sentence prints none and its "Answer the questions on each excerpt." one; Q6's three excerpt headings each print a bullet before their sentence, and "Now listen to a later excerpt ..." prints one; composing bullets as printed, none on the titles, "In the case of both (a) and (b),", "Answer (a) and (b).", "(a)/(b) Study this opening ...", the poem lines, PREPARATORY WORK (regular capitals, not bold) or the "(i) At A, ..." lines. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets "
• ", composing bullets " • ", tick boxes "□ ", unbulleted lines joined with a space, "
" between stems either side of option rows / answer lines) and compared every file string exactly, no normalisation: 131 of 131 identical. Then checked all 4,071 word tokens of the file strings, case and punctuation included, against the booklet text layers (fi/fl ligatures expanded): every token found. Code points in the file strings: • U+2022, – U+2013, — U+2014, ’ U+2019, □ U+25A1 only (no ligature characters, no straight apostrophes, no hyphen where an en dash is printed). The file has no readFromPage entries (none needed: no ♭/♯ or superscript is printed in any question line; the sharps and flats on composing p6, p8, p10 sit in the chord-bank grids, outside the strings). Every address matches the printed numbering: Q1, Q5 and Q6 number their parts afresh under each excerpt ("Q1 Excerpt 1(i)" ... "Q6 Excerpt 3(iv)"); Q2-Q4 (i)-(v); composing Section A Q1(a)/(b), Q2 (one ask, no (a)/(b) printed), Q3(a)/(b), Section B Q4-Q6; 44 listening + 8 composing = 52 asks, the file's count. Observations, not text differences: (1) Q1 Excerpt 2(ii) and Excerpt 3(iii) have excerptLine null by design (their notes: set-work knowledge about the work), so they have no excerptLine entry. (2) Section A Q1(a)/(b) join the tick-box list with "
", Q3(a)/(b) with a space, and Q3 puts "
" after "Answer (a) and (b)."; all permitted joiners. The printed part labels "(a)" / "(b)" (beside Q1's tick-box rows, opening Q3's "Study this opening ..." lines) are carried by the addresses. (3) Answer blanks that end a line (Q2(i), Q3(ii) both lines, Q5 Excerpt 1(iii), Q5 Excerpt 2(i), Q6 Excerpt 3(i)) are correctly not written; no blank falls inside a sentence in this sitting. (4) Q6 Excerpt 2(i): the rhythmic figure (accented dotted crotchet, quaver, minim) printed between "figure" and "is played" is not typed, per the lane ruling; the ask's figure box [0.08, 0.858, 0.95, 0.942] on p10 spans the sentence (y 0.869) and its options (y 0.912), so it carries the notation.
